text:
maria: Quick sync — Harbor pilot (ACME) asked for private deployment with HSM. We need to lock MVP scope + launch gating. @lex @aj @sasha :eyes:
lex: Thanks. Two big questions: runtime quantization tradeoffs and KV cache persistence for private mode. If we remove persistent KV for MVP, latency drops but cost rises.
aj: From infra side: we can do dedicated capacity prewarm for pilot, but HSM integration will add ~3 sprint lead time for ops + key rotation docs. Need acceptance criteria to scope rollout.
sasha: Security: HSM + customer audit trail is non-negotiable for their compliance. We can do a scoped HSM shim for pilot (no full HSM HA). Need dev account access and threat model review.
maria: Proposed cut for MVP pilot (minimize infra/security lift):
```
- Hosted API with dedicated capacity (no VPC) OR
- Private with HSM shim (single-region, no HA)
- No long-term persistent KV across restarts (best-effort caching)
- Rollout gated on: security signoff, infra capacity reservation, perf smoke test (p95 < 200ms for gen path)
```
oliver: Ops ask: if we go private with shim, we must freeze model upgrades for pilot and pin VM images. That reduces churn. Also need a simple rollback plan (route back to hosted).
lex: For runtime: if we pin model + disable persistent KV, we can ship smaller kernel changes. We'll need an infra flag for `--private-hsm-mode` and a fallback to hosted model. Can we commit to the perf SLO above?
maria: We should prioritize security signoff and infra prewarm. If those slip, fallback is Hosted Dedicated with HSM-mock for evaluation. Decision needed by EOD Wed so sales can commit to customer timeline.
sasha: I'll run the threat model and list required mitigations by Tue EOD. If infra can scope HSM shim (single region) it's acceptable.
aj: I can scope infra work: HSM shim + capacity pinning = 3 sprints; dedicated hosted prewarm = 1 sprint. We should map which sales date we can meet.
maria: Action items: @sasha produce signoff checklist (due Tue), @aj publish infra ETA + minimal deploy playbook (due Wed), @lex estimate runtime changes + perf smoke plan (due Wed). I'll coordinate customer expectations. :+1:
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: harbor-pilot-prewarm -> infra-reservation (pending manifest)
maria: Thanks — will follow up in the triage meeting tomorrow 9:30am. Keep threads short; escalate blockers.
